description: Create a live sign-up sheet on im-in.events from a title, slot names and a time zone. Returns the shareable sheet URL and emails a private manage and claim link to owner_email, the user's own address. One sheet per owner email a day.

owner_email.description: The user's email; the manage link is sent here

slots.description: One line per item people sign up for, 1 spot each. Add " x4" for 4 spots, or " (no limit)" so anyone can sign up, e.g. ["Week 1 snacks", "Setup crew x4", "Coming (no limit)"]

starts_at.description: Optional ISO datetime of the event

tz.description: IANA time zone of the event, e.g. "America/New_York"

name: create_signup_sheet
title: Create a live sign-up sheet
